spec_references: Module-level declarations: Class definition — Supports `object-field`, `method-defn` and `object-type-inclusion` members

reason: The negative test expects rejection of a class whose map-of-arrays field remains uninitialized: assigning through self.s["one"][0] requires reading the uninitialized field and does not initialize it. Class fields, initializer methods, assignment and nested field/member lvalues are supported, with no applicable restriction excluding this definite-initialization check.
test_design_notes: The @error annotation asserts a compile-time diagnostic on the uninitialized field declaration; invalid code within supported constructs remains in scope.
